scaffold._discoveryPainPoints:
1. [ProcessHandoffFriction] Leads going cold due to 4-24 hour response times while on tools (intensity 8/10, stage: Lead Received) ← flagged as binding
2. [DataSignalFriction] Systematic under-quoting due to lack of historical job cost data (intensity 9/10, stage: Quote Delivered) ← flagged as binding
3. [ProcessHandoffFriction] No capacity planning leads to over-commitment and scheduling conflicts (intensity 7/10, stage: Job Scheduled)
4. [ProcessHandoffFriction] Delayed invoicing directly impacts cash flow - invoices sent days or weeks late (intensity 8/10, stage: Invoice Prepared) ← flagged as binding
5. [GovernanceRiskFriction] BAS obligations arrive as quarterly financial shocks with no forward planning (intensity 9/10, stage: Requirements Identified) ← flagged as binding
6. [DataSignalFriction] No time tracking means unknown actual job profitability vs quoted amounts (intensity 8/10, stage: Work Executed) ← flagged as binding
7. [DataSignalFriction] Client history and job details exist only in tradie's memory (intensity 7/10, stage: Relationship Maintained)
8. [IncentiveCapacityFriction] 60-90 minutes unpaid admin work every evening due to lack of integrated systems (intensity 8/10, stage: Invoice Prepared) ← flagged as binding

pc_client_data_protection.name: Client Data Protection Policy
pc_client_data_protection.description: Mandatory protection of client personal and business information throughout the service lifecycle

outcomes.description: Must encrypt all client data at rest and in transit
Must obtain explicit consent before sharing client information
Cannot retain client data beyond business necessity period

pc_work_quality_standards.name: Work Quality Standards Policy
pc_work_quality_standards.description: Mandatory quality assurance and documentation requirements for all trade work execution

outcomes.description: Must document all work performed with photographic evidence
Must obtain client sign-off before marking job complete
Must verify compliance with relevant trade standards

exceptions.modification: Documentation may be completed within 24 hours

pc_financial_record_keeping.name: Financial Record Keeping Policy
pc_financial_record_keeping.description: Mandatory maintenance of accurate financial records for tax compliance and business management

outcomes.description: Must maintain all financial records for minimum 7 years
Must reconcile all payments within 30 days of receipt
Must backup financial data daily to secure location

pc_licensing_compliance.name: Trade Licensing Compliance Policy
pc_licensing_compliance.description: Mandatory maintenance of valid trade licenses and regulatory compliance for all work activities

conditions.expression: cc_trade_license:Active License is required for work

outcomes.description: Cannot perform trade work without valid current license
Must renew licenses at least 30 days before expiry
Must display license numbers on all quotes and invoices

pc_warranty_management.name: Warranty Management Policy
pc_warranty_management.description: Procedures for handling warranty claims and maintaining service quality commitments

conditions.expression: cc_work_completion_record:Client Acceptance exists for original work

outcomes.description: Must respond to warranty claims within 48 hours
Must assess warranty claims on-site within 5 business days
May charge for issues outside warranty scope after client agreement
